text: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Melbourne. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

result.keyword: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Melbourne. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

items.markdown:
For a $10M luxury property in Melbourne, the agencies with the strongest and most consistent track records in the ultra-prime market include [Kay & Burton](https://www.kayburton.com.au/), Marshall White , and [RT Edgar](https://www.rtedgar.com/) . These firms dominate high-net-worth transactions across prime inner-east and bayside suburbs like Toorak, South Yarra, and Brighton.[[1]](https://www.rtedgar.com/)[[2]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/ultimate-high/)[[3]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdneU4yNDFkMnB5GAo)

### Top Prestige Agencies in Melbourne

- [Kay & Burton](https://www.kayburton.com.au/) — Long-standing luxury specialists with deep intergenerational buyer networks locally and internationally (including Asia and the Middle East), famous for high-value Stonnington and Mornington Peninsula campaigns.[[1]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/ultimate-high/)
- Marshall White — Renowned for high-end auction results and volume in the elite inner-south and eastern suburbs , led by top-tier prestige agents like Marcus Chiminello who frequently handle state-record transactions.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdneU4yNDFkMnB5GAo)
- [RT Edgar](https://www.rtedgar.com/) — Operating for over 130 years, offering specialized blue-ribbon expertise across Toorak, Bayside, and Boroondara with a strong focus on period provenance and architectural luxury.[[1]](https://www.rtedgar.com/news/high-end-property-is-weathering-economic-ups-and-downs/)[[2]](https://www.rtedgar.com/)
- **Jellis Craig (Prestige)** — Highly effective localized market share and premium buyer databases across inner and leafy middle-ring elite suburbs.
- **Sotheby’s International Realty (Melbourne)** — Strong global feeder network and brand equity tailored specifically to ultra-high-net-worth international buyers.

If you can share the **specific suburb** and **property type** (e.g., modern architectural build vs. historic estate), I can help recommend the **individual lead agent** within these agencies who holds the strongest direct record for that specific asset class.
